title: The optimal order of convex-body covering density

result.label: The optimal order of convex-body covering density
result.statement: Determines the optimal worst-case covering density as (n n), for both lattice and unrestricted translative coverings. Every convex body in ℝ n , n ≥ 2, admits a lattice covering of density at most Cn n; centrally symmetric examples in every sufficiently large dimension require at least cn n even without the lattice restriction, for absolute c,C 0.
